svg.text: WARDLINE // x64 MULTI-OS ZERO-TRUST SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
Multi-OS Kernel Containment (Windows / Linux / macOS / FreeBSD), Brokered Workspace, Locked Vault & SSRF-Pinned Egress
1A. AI Hosts, Language SDKs & Operator CLI

1B. MCP Bridge, Wrap Proxy & Guard Encoder
wardline-mcp (1 MiB RPC cap, wrap, servers, --learn TOML)
Invariant: Zero vault keys, sockets, or child handles.
Framing: [u32 LE byte_len <= 16 MiB][UTF-8 JSON Frame]
Transport Hardening (Win32 Named Pipe / POSIX UDS):
Secret custody, file intake, key rotate & chunk scrub.
L0/L1/L1.5/L2 never silently downgrade to weaker tiers.
Unwraps env/sudo/nice; blocks LOLBins, -c/-e, SSRF & 7 fuzzers.
MAX_DEPTH=8 lineage CRL, RFC 9110 & redb egress budgets.
BLAKE3 Merkle proofs, Ed25519 seals & .tainted lockout.
ZONE 2: TRUSTED COMPUTING BASE (TCB) — wardline-guard.exe (12 forbid(unsafe) + platform/FFI)
Child cert caps MUST NOT exceed parent
Strips inherited host tokens & env vars
Vault secrets injected ONLY into granted child
Walks EVERY segment from base_dir (Win + Unix)
Verifies canonical path stays inside base_dir
Writes require consumed BLAKE3 ticket digest
NEVER handed verbatim to MCP or AI Client
Rolling boundary matcher detects granted secrets split across
arbitrary stdout/stderr pipe reads or HTTP response chunks.
Zero secret material survives serialization over Named Pipe.
WLG1 CBOR | Intent->Outcome | Events / Stats / Export
Chain + MerkleTree: BLAKE3 proofs & Signed Checkpoints
GuardResponse variants serialized over Named Pipe / Unix Domain Socket:
• GuardResponse::Ok -> Scrubbed stdout/stderr, HTTP status/body, FS data, exit_code
• GuardResponse::ApprovalRequired -> Deterministic ticket_id + BLAKE3 action_digest for HITL
• GuardResponse::Denied -> Policy rule, LOLBin, reparse/symlink, SSRF, or ISA reason
• GuardResponse::Error -> Typed Win32 / POSIX fault code (zero secret leak)
Cleanup verified on drop: AppContainer / NetNS torn down, FS ACEs revoked, SecretBytes zeroized.
AppContainer children hold ZERO network capabilities;
all HTTP(S) traffic MUST transit handle_http_fetch().
RFC 9110 method/target check + DestinationAlias + redb caps
3B. Anti-SSRF Host Filter & DNS IP Pinning
DENY CIDRs (Blocks Cloud IMDS & LAN Pivot):
3C. Pinned TLS Dial & Header Auth Inject
Connects directly to validated pinned SocketAddr.
Vault Header Inject: Bearer/API key attached ONLY
inside guard for policy-matched destination host.
Response Parse: httparse + capped streaming read
Headers + Body routed back through Step 5 Scrubber.

ZONE 4: MULTI-OS x64 ZIG KERNEL CONTAINMENT ENGINES (C-ABI v2)
4A. x64 Multi-OS Preflight & CET Mitigation Engine
• ALLOW: PE 0x8664 | ELF EM_X86_64 | Mach-O X86_64
• word0: DEP | SEHOP | ASLR | ACG | Win32k + NonMS-Bin
• Probes CET, Landlock ABI, cgroup v2 & tier_support_mask
4B. Native OS Kernel Containment (Win32 / POSIX Sandbox)
Per-OS Fail-Closed L0 / L1 / L1.5 / L2 Enforcers:
• Linux : Fail-closed Landlock + 22-call seccomp + cgroup v2
• macOS : Seatbelt SBPL + (deny process-fork) + VZ MicroVM
• FreeBSD : Capsicum cap_enter() capability mode + fexecve()
• L1.5/L2 : gVisor runsc / Firecracker / HCS + guest-agent
Deterministic Child Lifecycle, Limits & I/O Multiplexer:
• Win: CREATE_SUSPENDED + HANDLE_LIST + Job limits + IOCP reaper
• POSIX: FD close + setrlimit(AS/NPROC) + poll() timeout + SIGKILL
• Bounded stdout/stderr capture with fail-closed wall-clock timer
• defer: Terminate job/pgroup + Revoke FS ACEs + Delete container
or explicit L1 AppContainer / Landlock / SBPL scope.
Uncapped child escapes blocked by kernel ACLs
Zero trust in running guard daemon:
Merkle inclusion proofs, and Ed25519 seals
plus signed MicroVM golden image manifests.
Exit 0 : Chain, Merkle root & image OK
